title: MacBrains Labs ANE Research Records
description:
Version v0.6.0 adds a package record for the strict-LUT4 one-segment build of a width-pruned LFM3-1.7B (feed-forward 7680 to 7168, 1.65B parameters), released as lfm3-1.7b-ane v0.2.0. Every large weight is a 4-bit lookup table (143 LUT4 operations). Core ML's compute plan assigns all 1,756 device-assigned operations to the Apple Neural Engine at 256, 512, 1024, 2048 and 4096 positions (the remaining enumerated operations are constants and the lookup-table carriers, which carry no device assignment); the token-embedding lookup runs on the host. Same-chip decode: 39.9 tok/s median at 256 and 23.5 tok/s at 4096 positions (INDICATIVE — measured on a loaded machine; the pre-run load gate never passed — 25 polls, minimum 5.68 — and individual runs began at loads between about 4.3 and 10.3) on Apple A18 Pro (Mac17,5), macOS 27.3 (26C5047e). Scope: one device; ANE hardware activity during decode measured with powermetrics; per-operation execution INFERRED from compute-plan placement; output quality measured against the pruned checkpoint only (31–32/39 on the lab scorecard); a 3,939-token prompt run completed to position 3,970 of 4,096 but a literal full-cache run was not demonstrated; runtime binary-only; no novelty claim. Records are reviewed summaries, not peer-reviewed results.

Reviewed package SHA-256 ec26204bae046fbf2ef0ed374871c69a871d1f0386fa85ebe045b27562afb2d3; reviewed record SHA-256 cc1edc7288bc821c4fecd8b10e004d979a53d0845cc39290830f571d1cd5847d.

The reported measurements have not been independently replicated by this deposit.
